title: Naturality of the sheaf tensor comparison isomorphism
statement: Let (C,J) be a site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, A,Aprime,B,Bprime sheaves of R-modules, f:Aprime -> A and g:Bprime -> B. Let S denote module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and c(A,B):A tensor B -> S(A.val tensor B.val) the canonical comparison isomorphism [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then (f tensor g);c(A,B) = c(Aprime,Bprime);S(f.val tensor g.val). This is an equality of sheaf module morphisms. No invertibility of f or g, boundedness or assumption on sections is required.

source.place: Section 03EK (tensor product as sheafification), and Lemma 03CY (module sheafification universal property); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03EK and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03CY

proof.text: Let epsilon be the invertible counit of module sheafification S. Apply naturality of (asIso epsilon).inv to f and g. Tensor interchange rewrites the tensor of these equations as (f tensor g);(epsilon(A) inverse tensor epsilon(B) inverse) = (epsilon(Aprime) inverse tensor epsilon(Bprime) inverse);(S(f.val) tensor S(g.val)). The identity scalar restriction is definitionally the underlying presheaf functor.

Postcompose with the tensorator mu of S at A.val,B.val. Tensorator naturality replaces (S(f.val) tensor S(g.val));mu(A.val,B.val) by mu(Aprime.val,Bprime.val);S(f.val tensor g.val). By definition c is the tensor of inverse counits followed by mu, so reassociation gives the stated equality. This applies to identity maps, zero maps and zero objects without any special case or invertibility of f,g.

proof_origin.place: Section 03EK and Lemma 03CY, read online by both workers; K1 second reader closed the comparison using inverse-counit naturality, tensor interchange and Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural.

MonoidalClosed has whiskerLeft/Right_tensorObjIsoSheafification_hom only for C : Type u and Category.{u} C. SheafificationTensor has a private tensorIso_natural with that restriction. No public theorem matches the separate site universes of this statement.
Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural gives two-variable tensorator naturality. Used with inverse-counit naturality to close the comparison proof.

from.place: First step of lem-sc-hom-tensor-section-natural: naturality of tensorObjIsoSheafification before passing to its inverse, forgetting and composing with the sheafification unit.

lean.statement:
theorem homTensorComparison_natural {A A' B B' : Mod}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (g : B' ⟶ B) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).hom =
      (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A' B').hom ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification
          (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).obj)).map
          (f.val ⊗ₘ g.val)
